pinyin: wěn dìng yā dǎo yī qiè

meaning.en: Social stability must come first, because reform and development depend on it.
meaning.zh: 保持社会稳定是首要任务，改革和发展都以此为前提。

examples.zh: 改革要稳步推进，稳定压倒一切。
examples.en: Reform must advance steadily; stability overrides everything.

examples.zh: 政府工作报告再次强调稳定压倒一切。
examples.en: The government work report stressed again that stability overrides everything.

usage.en: A political slogan of the late 1980s and 1990s. Formal, official language; sometimes quoted critically as justifying curbs on change.
usage.zh: 20世纪八十年代末至九十年代的政治口号，官方用语；有时也被批评性地引用。

pinyin: lū qǐ xiù zi jiā yóu gàn
literal: roll up · sleeves · add · oil · do
natural: roll up your sleeves and get on with it

meaning.en: Get down to work with energy and determination.
meaning.zh: 鼓起干劲，积极投入工作。

examples.zh: 新年伊始，大家撸起袖子加油干。
examples.en: At the start of the year, everyone rolled up their sleeves and got on with it.

examples.zh: 目标定了，咱们撸起袖子加油干吧。
examples.en: The goal is set; let's roll up our sleeves.

origin.source: 习近平《二〇一七年新年贺词》（2016年12月31日）

story.en: In his 2017 New Year message Xi Jinping said that 'we must roll up our sleeves and work hard'.
story.zh: 2016年12月31日习近平在新年贺词中说：“撸起袖子加油干。”

usage.en: A popular slogan from Xi Jinping's 2017 New Year message, now common in workplaces and advertising. Casual.
usage.zh: 出自习近平《二〇一七年新年贺词》，如今在职场和广告中常见。口语。

pinyin: kōng tán wù guó, shí gàn xīng bāng
literal: empty · talk · harm · country, real · work · raise · nation
natural: empty talk ruins the country; hard work makes it flourish

meaning.en: Idle talk harms the nation, while practical work brings it prosperity.
meaning.zh: 光说不做会耽误国家，踏实做事才能让国家兴盛。

equivalents: talk is cheap, action builds nations

examples.zh: 空谈误国，实干兴邦，我们要把规划落到实处。
examples.en: Empty talk harms the nation and practical work makes it prosper; we must put the plan into effect.

examples.zh: 校长用“空谈误国，实干兴邦”勉励学生。
examples.en: The head used 'empty talk ruins the country, hard work makes it flourish' to encourage the students.

origin.source: 习近平在《复兴之路》展览上的讲话（2012年11月29日）

story.en: On 29 November 2012, visiting the 'Road to Revival' exhibition, Xi Jinping said 'empty talk harms the country, hard work makes it flourish'.
story.zh: 2012年11月29日习近平参观《复兴之路》展览时说：“空谈误国，实干兴邦。”

usage.en: Echoes the older 清谈误国 (idle talk ruins the state). Formal, positive; very common in speeches.
usage.zh: 呼应更早的“清谈误国”。正式，褒义；演讲中很常见。

pinyin: lǎo hǔ cāng yíng yī qǐ dǎ
natural: swat the tigers and the flies together

meaning.en: A phrase for an anti-corruption drive that targets both senior officials ('tigers') and petty ones ('flies').
meaning.zh: 反腐败既要查处高级官员（老虎），也要查处基层的小官小吏（苍蝇）。

equivalents: go after big and small corrupt officials

examples.zh: 反腐败要老虎苍蝇一起打。
examples.en: The anti-corruption campaign must swat tigers and flies together.

examples.zh: 新闻说今年老虎苍蝇一起打，查处了不少人。
examples.en: The news says tigers and flies were swatted together this year, with many cases.

origin.source: 习近平在中央纪委二次全会上的讲话（2013年1月）

story.en: In January 2013 Xi Jinping told the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection that both 'tigers' and 'flies' must be dealt with.
story.zh: 2013年1月习近平在十八届中央纪委二次全会上提出：“老虎苍蝇一起打”。

usage.en: Used in official and media reports since 2013. 老虎 = senior officials, 苍蝇 = low-ranking ones. Neutral.
usage.zh: 2013年以来常见于官方和媒体报道。老虎指高官，苍蝇指基层小官。

text: 把权力关进制度的笼子里
pinyin: bǎ quán lì guān jìn zhì dù de lóng zi lǐ
literal: BA · power · lock · into · system · 's · cage · inside
natural: lock power in the cage of institutions

meaning.en: Use rules and institutions to restrain the exercise of power.
meaning.zh: 用制度约束权力的行使。

examples.zh: 反腐的关键是把权力关进制度的笼子里。
examples.en: The key to fighting corruption is to put power in the cage of institutions.

examples.zh: 要把权力关进制度的笼子里，让监督落到实处。
examples.en: Power must be locked in the cage of institutions and oversight made real.

origin.source: 习近平在中央纪委二次全会上的讲话（2013年1月22日）

story.en: In January 2013 Xi Jinping said that power should be locked in the cage of institutions.
story.zh: 2013年1月22日习近平提出“要加强对权力运行的制约和监督，把权力关进制度的笼子里”。

usage.en: Formal, used in official and media discussions of governance and anti-corruption since 2013.
usage.zh: 正式，2013年以来常见于治理与反腐方面的官方和媒体讨论。

text: 房子是用来住的，不是用来炒的
pinyin: fáng zi shì yòng lái zhù de, bù shì yòng lái chǎo de
literal: house · is · used · to · live · -in, not · is · used · to · speculate · -on
natural: houses are for living in, not for speculation

meaning.en: Housing should serve people's needs, not be treated as a speculative asset.
meaning.zh: 住房应当满足居住需要，不应成为炒作对象。

equivalents: homes are for living in, not for flipping

examples.zh: 房子是用来住的，不是用来炒的，这是房地产政策的定位。
examples.en: Houses are for living in, not for speculation; that is the position of housing policy.

examples.zh: 别想着炒房了，房子是用来住的，不是用来炒的。
examples.en: Forget speculating; houses are for living in, not for speculation.

origin.source: 习近平在中央经济工作会议上的讲话（2016年12月）

story.en: At the December 2016 Central Economic Work Conference Xi Jinping stressed that houses are for living in, not for speculation; the 2017 Party congress repeated it.
story.zh: 2016年12月中央经济工作会议提出“房子是用来住的，不是用来炒的”，2017年十九大报告重申。

usage.en: Official housing-policy line, widely quoted in property news. Neutral.
usage.zh: 官方住房政策的定位，房地产新闻中经常引用。中性。

pinyin: xìng fú dōu shì fèn dòu chū lái de
literal: happiness · all · is · struggle · out · come
natural: all happiness is earned through struggle

meaning.en: Happiness has to be won by one's own hard work.
meaning.zh: 幸福要靠自己的奋斗去争取。

equivalents: you have to work for happiness

examples.zh: 幸福都是奋斗出来的，没有谁能躺着得到。
examples.en: All happiness is earned through struggle; nobody gets it lying down.

examples.zh: 她用幸福都是奋斗出来的这句话激励自己。
examples.en: She encourages herself with the words that all happiness is earned through struggle.

origin.source: 习近平《二〇一八年新年贺词》（2017年12月31日）

story.en: In his 2018 New Year message Xi Jinping said that 'happiness is all earned through struggle'.
story.zh: 2017年12月31日习近平在新年贺词中说：“幸福都是奋斗出来的。”

usage.en: A popular motivational line since 2018, common in speeches and ads. Neutral to positive.
usage.zh: 2018年以来流行的励志语，常见于讲话和广告。中性偏褒。

pinyin: gōng chéng bù bì zài wǒ
literal: achievement · done · need not · be with · me

meaning.en: Be willing to lay foundations for others to enjoy the credit later; do not seek personal credit.
meaning.zh: 愿意为后人打基础，不计较个人功劳。

equivalents: work for the long term, not for credit

examples.zh: 干部要有功成不必在我的境界。
examples.en: Officials should have the outlook that success need not be mine.

examples.zh: 功成不必在我，种树的人不一定乘凉。
examples.en: Success need not be mine; the one who plants the tree may not enjoy its shade.

origin.source: 习近平在全国组织工作会议上的讲话（2013年6月）

story.en: In June 2013 Xi Jinping told officials to have the spirit that success need not be mine, but that I must play my part.
story.zh: 2013年6月习近平在全国组织工作会议上讲到“功成不必在我，功成必定有我”。

usage.en: Often paired with 功成必定有我 ('but I must play my part'). Formal, positive.
usage.zh: 常与“功成必定有我”连用。正式，褒义。

pinyin: yī zhāng lán tú huì dào dǐ
natural: draw to the end with one blueprint

meaning.en: Stick to one plan consistently until it is completed, regardless of changes in personnel.
meaning.zh: 一个规划坚持到底，不因人事变动而改变。

equivalents: stay the course with one plan

examples.zh: 城市规划要一张蓝图绘到底。
examples.en: City planning should follow one blueprint to the end.

examples.zh: 新班子上任后继续一张蓝图绘到底。
examples.en: The new team continued to follow the one blueprint to the end.

usage.en: A phrase from official speeches on policy continuity; used in government and business. Formal.
usage.zh: 官方讲话中关于政策连续性的说法，政府和企业都用。正式。

pinyin: jí zhōng lì liàng bàn dà shì
natural: pool strength to accomplish big things

meaning.en: The idea that a country can marshal resources behind major projects.
meaning.zh: 集中人力物力财力完成重大任务。

examples.zh: 航天工程体现了集中力量办大事的优势。
examples.en: The space programme reflects the strength of pooling resources for big undertakings.

examples.zh: 集中力量办大事，是这个体制的特点。
examples.en: Pooling strength to get big things done is a feature of this system.

usage.en: Often described as an advantage of China's system; Deng Xiaoping spoke in this vein in 1992. Sometimes discussed critically too, in terms of cost. Formal.
usage.zh: 常被说成是中国体制的优势，邓小平1992年有过类似论述。有时也被从成本角度讨论。正式。

natural: urgent dispatch at 800 li a day

meaning.en: The fastest courier service of imperial China, covering 800 li a day for urgent official messages; now used for anything extremely urgent.
meaning.zh: 古代驿站最紧急的文书传递，日行八百里；今泛指十万火急的事。

examples.zh: 老板八百里加急催我交报告。
examples.en: The boss sent an urgent message to rush me for the report.

examples.zh: 快递员八百里加急把药送到了。
examples.en: The courier rushed the medicine over at top speed.

usage.en: Used in imperial dispatches (the Qing relayed messages at 400, 600 and 800 li a day by relay horses). Today usually humorous, for urgent messages. Casual.
usage.zh: 古代以接力的快马传递紧急公文（清代有四百里、六百里、八百里加急）。今天多带诙谐意味。口语。

natural: urgent dispatch at 600 li a day

meaning.en: An urgent courier grade of imperial China, 600 li a day; now used for very urgent matters.
meaning.zh: 古代驿站紧急文书的传递等级，日行六百里；今泛指很紧急的事。

examples.zh: 六百里加急的文书送到了京城。
examples.en: The dispatch sent at 600 li a day reached the capital.

examples.zh: 项目出了问题，领导六百里加急发来通知。
examples.en: The project hit trouble and the boss sent an urgent notice.

usage.en: Slower than 八百里加急 but still urgent; used in Qing court records. Today usually humorous. Casual.
usage.zh: 比八百里加急慢一级，仍属紧急；见于清代宫廷记录。今天多带诙谐意味。口语。

meaning.en: Two signs carried in an official's procession in imperial China, ordering the crowd to make way and keep quiet.
meaning.zh: 旧时官员出行仪仗中的牌子，命令百姓回避、保持安静。

examples.zh: 戏台上摆出回避肃静的牌子，十分威严。
examples.en: The stage displays the 'Make way' and 'Silence' signs, looking very imposing.

examples.zh: 衙门前竖着回避肃静的牌子。
examples.en: In front of the yamen stood signs reading 'Keep clear, be silent'.

usage.en: Seen in historical dramas, where two signs, 回避 and 肃静, flank the magistrate's seat or procession. Now used humorously for demanding quiet. Formal.
usage.zh: 常见于古装戏，“回避”“肃静”两块牌子立于官员仪仗或公堂两旁。今天也被戏用来要求安静。

meaning.en: An imperial edict formula ordering an official's immediate dismissal.
meaning.zh: 皇帝谕旨中的用语，命令立即撤销官员职务。

examples.zh: 圣旨上写着：某某玩忽职守，着即革职。
examples.en: The edict read: so-and-so has neglected his duty and is dismissed at once.

examples.zh: 古装剧里常有“着即革职”的台词。
examples.en: The line 'is to be dismissed at once' often appears in costume dramas.

usage.en: Found in Qing edicts; 着 here is pronounced zhuó (order, direct). Today used humorously for sacking someone. Formal, historical.
usage.zh: 见于清代谕旨；“着”读zhuó，意为命令。今天常戏用于炒人。正式，带历史色彩。

meaning.en: Closing formula of an imperial edict (钦此) with the officials' reply of obedience (钦遵).
meaning.zh: 圣旨结尾的套语“钦此”，加上官员接旨后的回答“钦遵”，表示遵旨。

equivalents: by imperial order, to be obeyed

examples.zh: 圣旨念到钦此钦遵，大臣才起身谢恩。
examples.en: When the edict reached its closing formula, the ministers rose to give thanks.

examples.zh: 他写完通知，戏说一句“钦此钦遵”。
examples.en: After writing the notice, he jokingly added 'so ordered, so obeyed'.

usage.en: 钦此 closed edicts; 钦遵 was in officials' memorials and replies. Today used jokingly to end an order. Formal, historical.
usage.zh: 圣旨以“钦此”结束，臣下复奏时常用“钦遵”。今天常戏用于结束一道命令。

natural: dismissed from rank but kept in post

meaning.en: A Qing punishment in which an official lost his rank but kept doing his job, hoping to earn restoration by good service.
meaning.zh: 清代官员处分的一种：革去官衔但仍留原职，以观后效。

examples.zh: 清代犯错的官员有时被革职留任。
examples.en: In the Qing, officials who erred were sometimes dismissed from rank but kept in post.

examples.zh: 他被处以革职留任，要戴罪立功。
examples.en: He was dismissed from rank but kept in post, to redeem himself by good work.

usage.en: A Qing disciplinary term; today it appears in historical writing and as a humorous word for being put on probation. Formal.
usage.zh: 清代处分用语，今天多见于历史文章，也戏指留用察看。

natural: an important place of military secrets

meaning.en: A place where state or military secrets are handled and which ordinary people may not enter; originally the Grand Council in the Qing.
meaning.zh: 处理军国机密的重要场所，闲人不得入内；原指清代军机处。

examples.zh: 门口写着“军机重地，闲人免进”。
examples.en: A sign at the gate says 'Military secrets zone, no entry for outsiders'.

examples.zh: 老板的办公室是军机重地，不能乱闯。
examples.en: The boss's office is a top-secret zone; don't barge in.

usage.en: Often in the sign 军机重地，闲人免进. Today also used jokingly for any place that is off-limits. Formal to neutral.
usage.zh: 常见于“军机重地，闲人免进”的牌子。今天也戏指任何不让外人进入的地方。
